Samira (SRE): Following the DR postmortem, I'm locking owners for the follow-ups. Reply as: owner | ETA (date) | done condition. Keep it short.

Evan (NetEng): I'll take routing/DNS failover validation. Evan | 2026-04-06 | canary run shows BGP redirect + DNS TTL swap completes within 60s for test prefix. Blocker: need test prefix ACL.

Lola (Backup Eng): I'll own snapshot consistency and sample restores. Lola | 2026-04-02 | automated daily restore runs in staging + checksum match for 3 consecutive runs. Blocker: intermittent object-store timeouts (ticket BACK-301).

Carlos (Oncall): I'll update the restore runbook with KV priming + synthetic warmup snippet. Carlos | 2026-03-28 | PR merged with explicit priming step and traffic-gate checklist.

Yusuf (Platform PM): I'll own the game-day schedule and war-room template. Yusuf | 2026-04-16 | calendar invites sent, runbook linked, war-room doc reviewed.

Samira (SRE): ops rule: all PRs must include tag `dr-followup-2026` and a one-line acceptance criteria in the PR body: owner | ETA | rollback plan | test-plan. I'll spot-check before merge.

Evan (NetEng): created NET-3301 for test prefix + ACLs. PR for canary harness coming: https://git.redwood/repo/net/PR-4301 (WIP).

Lola (Backup Eng): opened BACK-301 with initial logs and a failing-restore repro. Running a trimmed restore job now; will update sheet.

Carlos (Oncall): PR: https://git.redwood/repo/runbooks/PR-4310 - KV priming and warmup. reviewers: Samira, Lee. Added synthetic warmup snippet: hit top-20 keys at 200rps for 5m.

Yusuf (Platform PM): calendar placeholder: "DR game-day dry run" 2026-04-16 09:00 UTC. I'll drop war-room template and invite list in the sheet.

Samira (SRE): added a follow-up tracker sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/DR-FOLLOWUPS-2026 (internal). Update with PR/ticket links + status. Weekly check-ins every Mon 09:00 UTC until closed.

OpsBot: Reminder created: channel=#incidents, cadence=weekly, day=Mon, time=09:00 UTC, tag=dr-followups.

Lola (Backup Eng): first automated restore completed in staging; checksum mismatch on object 2026-03-26. BACK-301 updated. Scheduling triage Monday 09:30 PT.

Evan (NetEng): test prefix provisioned. running initial dry-run of BGP/DNS swap with --dry-run and --revert-after flags.

Samira (SRE): summary: Evan NET-3301 (routing) ETA 2026-04-06; Lola BACK-301 (restores) ETA 2026-04-02; Carlos runbook PR ETA 2026-03-28; Yusuf game-day ETA 2026-04-16. Flag blockers in the sheet or ping me. :white_check_mark:
